Name: LanderHub
Description: Isla's escape pod, rebuilt as the milestone terminal. It grows with every tier, and it is the return capsule in Ending A.

Name: Workbench
Description: The galley table. Hold to craft any Press or Assembler recipe by hand.

Name: SignalTower
Description: The tower site on the sand. Each delivered phase grows one section and sends one message home.

Name: SuitFabricator
Description: Builds suit equipment: dive mask, scanner, zipline harness, glider pack.

Name: TideLab
Description: Research station: kelp, glass, pearl and storm research trees. Also decodes data cores.

Name: Translator
Description: Turns Glimmer picture-words into text. Count their fish right and it learns more.

Name: TradeBuoy
Description: Glimmer trades (fish x 5 = units wanted, chests = pearls paid) and the pearl shop. Needs a working Translator.

Name: Smelter
Description: One input. Ore to ingots.

Name: Press
Description: One input. Plates, rods, bolts, wire, cable, reefcrete, beams, pipes, shards.

Name: Kiln
Description: One input, heat. Glass and kelp char.

Name: Assembler
Description: Two inputs.

Name: Foundry
Description: Two inputs, steel.

Name: Refinery
Description: Fluid in, solid or fluid out. Tar products and glow gel.

Name: Manufactory
Description: Three inputs. Heavy frames, control modules, light cells.

Name: ResonanceForge
Description: Two inputs. Tunes deep crystal into resonators.

Name: DrillMk1
Description: Sits on an ore vent, lime bed, sand dune or storm spire. 60/min on a normal node (impure x0.5, pure x2). ExtractItem comes from the node.

Name: DrillMk2
Description: Sits on an ore vent, lime bed, sand dune or storm spire. 120/min on a normal node (impure x0.5, pure x2). ExtractItem comes from the node.

Name: DrillMk3
Description: Sits on an ore vent, lime bed, sand dune or storm spire. 240/min on a normal node (impure x0.5, pure x2). ExtractItem comes from the node.

Name: KelpHarvester
Description: Floats on a kelp bed. 60 glowkelp/min on a normal bed.

Name: SeaPump
Description: Any open water: 120 seawater/min. Placed over a tar seep it draws tar instead (impure 60, normal 120, pure 240/min).

Name: LightningRod
Description: Takes the strikes so your machines don't: no fuse trips within 30 m. During storms it collects 6 storm crystals/min.

Name: TrenchDrill
Description: Sits on a trench vent in the Glimmer Deep. 60 deep crystal/min on a normal vent.

Name: SalvagedSolar
Description: A panel and battery pack from the wreck. Steady 8 MW. The wreck has 12.

Name: KelpBurner
Description: 30 MW. Burns biofuel (or kelp pulp, or raw glowkelp). Dirties the water a little (counts from Phase 3).

Name: FuelBurner
Description: 75 MW. Burns kelp char, tar fuel or biofuel. Strong, fast and dirty.

Name: TidalTurbine
Description: Glimmer blueprint. Sits in a tidal race. 50 MW on a normal race (impure x0.5, pure x2). No fuel, no runoff.

Name: GlowBank
Description: Glimmer blueprint. 120 MW from light cells (1.5/min). Clean.

Name: Accumulator
Description: Stores 100 MWh, charges and discharges at up to 100 MW. Rides out storms and night dips.

Name: BeltMk1
Description: 60 items/min. Cost per 8 m cell. Over water it rides on pontoons (1 float per 2 cells).

Name: BeltMk2
Description: 120 items/min. Cost per 8 m cell.

Name: BeltMk3
Description: 270 items/min. Cost per 8 m cell.

Name: BeltLift
Description: Moves a belt up or down one floor (4 m).

Name: Splitter
Description: One in, three out.

Name: Merger
Description: Three in, one out.

Name: StorageCrate
Description: 24 slots. One belt in, one out.

Name: Pipe
Description: 300 fluid/min. Cost per 8 m. Light head-lift only: up to 10 m, no pumps.

Name: PowerPole
Description: 4 connections, cables up to 50 m with sag. Ziplines ride the cables.

Name: Skiff
Description: The one boat. 12 m/s, 24 cargo slots, burns 1 biofuel every 2 min.

Name: Foundation
Description: 8 x 8 m. Heights 1, 2 and 4 m are variants of this piece (same cost). Snaps to the 8 m grid.

Name: FloatingPlatform
Description: 8 x 8 m pontoon foundation on open water. The planet's signature build.

Name: Ramp
Description: 8 x 8 x 2 m ramp.

Name: Stairs
Description: 8 x 8 x 4 m stairs.

Name: Wall
Description: 8 x 4 m wall on a foundation edge. A door variant has the same cost.

Name: WindowWall
Description: 8 x 4 m wall with a window.

Name: Catwalk
Description: 4 m catwalk, railings included. Straight, corner, T and stairs pieces.

Name: Pillar
Description: 4 m support pillar.

Name: Roof
Description: 8 x 8 m roof panel.

Name: Breakwater
Description: 8 m sea wall. Belts within 32 m don't snap in storms.

Name: ReefFilter
Description: Glimmer design. Cleans runoff: +3 Ocean Health per hour while powered. The first three near the Glimmer reef: +3 trust each.
